claims.claim_text: Seven metabolites were strictly (FDR-significant, same-direction) replicated between Franzosa and iHMP for IBD vs. Control: N-acetylputrescine, adrenic acid, arachidonic acid, eicosatrienoic acid, ketodeoxycholate, putrescine, taurine.
claims.key_columns_used: contrast_summary row for ibd_vs_control: replicated_metabolite_contrast_events, unique_replicated_metabolites; primary_replicated_metabolite rows for metabolite_name
claims.notes: 7 replication events across 7 unique metabolites; independently cross-checked against strict_FDR_unique_metabolites_full_expanded in stage3a_within_disease_concordance.csv (also 7). Exact metabolite list: ['N-acetylputrescine', 'adrenic acid', 'arachidonic acid', 'eicosatrienoic acid', 'ketodeoxycholate', 'putrescine', 'taurine'].

claims.claim_text: By IBD subtype contrast, strict replication counts were: IBD-vs-Control=7, CD-vs-Control=3, UC-vs-Control=0. The CD-vs-Control set (3) is a subset of the IBD-vs-Control set (7); UC-vs-Control had no metabolites meeting the strict replication criterion (no uc_vs_control contrast rows in the audit at all).
claims.notes: Do not read the 'IBD replicated events=10' row in stage3_final_results_numbers.csv as 10 IBD-vs-control metabolites — that row sums IBD-vs-control (7) and CD-vs-control (3) replication events across contrasts. A relabelled copy for citation is at stage3_final_results_numbers_relabelled.csv (generated by relabel_stage3_final_results_numbers.py); the original is left untouched.

claims.claim_text: IBD within-disease, cross-cohort effect-size concordance: Spearman rho=0.782 (p=1.78e-12), same-sign proportion=0.745 over n=55 complete metabolites.
claims.notes: Full expanded IBD replication count is reproduced from the validated post-reopening replication audit; Stage 3A-subset count is lower when replicated metabolites are outside the strict four-cohort 56.

claims.claim_text: CRC within-disease, cross-cohort effect-size concordance: Spearman rho=0.134 (p=0.324), same-sign proportion=0.536 over n=56 complete metabolites.
claims.notes: CRC strict replication is 0 in the validated expanded DA audit and in the Stage 3A strict subset.

claims.claim_text: Across 56 metabolites, 2 showed significant HC3-robust ordered-state linear associations after BH correction (C00327_Citrulline, C03793_N6,N6,N6-Trimethyllysine); 6 showed significant Spearman associations with ordered state in the rank-based sensitivity analysis. These are two distinct tests: the HC3 result is an ordered-state linear association, not evidence of a monotonic trajectory — e.g. C00327_Citrulline's profile_pattern is 'irregular', not monotonic.
claims.key_columns_used: ordered_state_beta, robust_hc3_se, BH_FDR, spearman_rho, spearman_BH_FDR, profile_pattern, ordered_state_direction
claims.notes: HC3-significant metabolites and their profile_pattern: {'C00327_Citrulline': 'irregular', 'C03793_N6,N6,N6-Trimethyllysine': 'early_peak'}. Do not describe these two as a 'monotonic progression' — only the separate Spearman-rank sensitivity tests monotonicity directly. Underlying per-state median z-score profiles are in stage3b_yachida_ordered_state_profiles.csv; Healthy-vs-Advanced-CRC contrast is in stage3b_yachida_early_vs_advanced_summary.csv.

claims.claim_text: The IBD-replicated metabolites (putrescine, N-acetylputrescine, taurine) were additionally evaluated for a CRC-stage-ordered trend in Yachida.
claims.notes: Intersection of the 7 strictly-replicated IBD metabolites with the Yachida ordered-state metabolite panel.

claims.claim_text: No metabolites met the strict (FDR-significant, same-direction) replication criterion between Sinha and Yachida for CRC vs. Control/Healthy.
claims.notes: CRC strict replication is 0 in the validated expanded DA audit and in the Stage 3A strict subset.

claims.claim_text: None of the 24 cross-disease (IBD-vs-CRC) Spearman correlation tests survived BH-FDR correction.
claims.notes: Distinct from within-disease concordance (see within_disease_concordance_ibd/_crc claims): this tests IBD effect sizes against CRC effect sizes directly, not each disease against itself.

claims.claim_text: No metabolite was simultaneously a strictly-replicated Stage 3A within-disease candidate AND a BH-FDR-significant Stage 3B Yachida ordered-state association with a coherent direction across both.
